Collagen Myths: Separating Fact from Fiction

Collagen is everywhere. From beauty aisles to health stores, it’s become the go-to supplement for skin, joints, and overall wellness. But with popularity comes misinformation. How do you separate marketing claims from real science? Let’s explore the most common myths and uncover the truth about collagen.

Myth 1: All Collagen Supplements Are the Same

Not all collagen is created equal. Many brands make big promises, but the key lies in formulation, absorption, and supporting ingredients. Ingenious Collagen+ is backed by rigorous clinical testing and published in the American Journal of Dermatology – setting a gold standard for transparency and efficacy.

Many products use generic collagen peptides without considering molecular size, bioavailability, or complementary ingredients. Ingenious Collagen+ ensures collagen peptides are optimally sized (2000 Daltons or smaller) for absorption. Plus, its patented capsule technology protects the peptides until they reach the small intestine – the site of maximum nutrient uptake.

Myth 2: Liquid Collagen Is More Effective

Liquids might seem convenient, but they have significant downsides. Their instability requires artificial preservatives, flavourings, and emulsifiers to extend shelf life and mask unpleasant tastes. These ultra-processed additives serve no benefit to your body.

More importantly, liquids break down in the stomach before reaching the small intestine. Proteins, including collagen peptides, are naturally degraded by stomach acid and digestive enzymes. Without protection, absorption is inconsistent and unpredictable. Ingenious Collagen+ uses patented capsule technology to ensure peptides stay intact and reach the bloodstream effectively.

Myth 3: Powdered Collagen is the Purest Form

Unflavoured collagen powders can be free from additives, but they lack essential co-factors that enhance effectiveness. Many contain hidden ultra-processed chemicals, especially those marketed as ‘creamers’ or flavoured variants.

Another key issue is inconsistency in dosing. With powders, measuring exact amounts daily can be tricky, leading to fluctuations in intake and absorption. Ingenious Collagen+ provides a precise, repeatable dose every time, eliminating guesswork and ensuring consistency.

Myth 4: Marine and Bovine Collagen Are Equally Effective

Marine collagen has been shown to have greater bioactivity compared to bovine collagen. While bovine collagen is often a byproduct of the meat industry, marine collagen is sustainably sourced and specifically produced for supplementation. Ingenious Collagen+ prioritises purity, sourcing its marine collagen from free-swimming, sustainably harvested fish to ensure the highest quality.

Myth 5: Collagen Can Be Added to Hot Drinks Without Losing Efficacy

Adding collagen powders to hot coffee or tea can break down peptides before they reach your digestive system, making them less bioactive.

In contrast, Ingenious Collagen+ is protected within its capsule, ensuring peptides remain intact no matter what beverage you drink alongside it. The capsule’s design allows for targeted release in the small intestine, maximising absorption and effectiveness.

Myth 6: Collagen Alone Is Enough for Skin Health

Collagen is crucial, but it’s only part of the picture. To support skin, joint, and overall wellness, you need more than just peptides. Ingenious Collagen+ combines collagen with an advanced HA complex (20% more effective than standard hyaluronic acid) and natural Astaxanthin – one of the most powerful antioxidants in nature. This synergy amplifies hydration, elasticity, and cellular protection for superior results.

Myth 7: Higher Doses of Collagen Mean Better Results

More isn’t always better. The body can only absorb a limited amount of collagen at a time, and excess amounts may be broken down and excreted. Quality and delivery method matter far more than sheer quantity.

With Ingenious Collagen+, every dose is precisely calibrated for optimal absorption, so you get the maximum benefit without waste. The formulation is designed to work efficiently with your body’s natural processes, ensuring results that are both effective and repeatable.

Myth 8: Collagen Supplements Don’t Need Clinical Testing

Many brands claim to be ‘clinically proven,’ but not all clinical trials are created equal. Some companies use unregulated trial organisations or selectively publish favourable results. A clinical study only holds weight if it’s statistically significant and conducted under rigorous conditions.

Ingenious Collagen+ has been tested by the UK’s leading clinical trial organisation and published in the highly respected American Journal of Dermatology. These results withstand the most stringent scrutiny, proving its effectiveness with real scientific backing.

The Truth About Collagen

Misinformation clouds the supplement industry, but science cuts through the noise. Ingenious Collagen+ stands apart with clinical validation, patented absorption technology, and a commitment to quality. Choosing the right collagen means looking beyond marketing claims – because results matter.
